notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.4
notes.content:
NEW in this version:
* Required stars to unlock levels reduced
* UI performance improvements

Bugs fixed:
* Armor Red Baron 1000 was not displaying correctly while facing sideways
* Chest collection achievement was not completable
* Stage overview did not reflect collected special (Core hidden)
* Stage overview did not indicate collectable chest (Kingdom)

Thank you for playing! If you enjoy our game, please consider leaving us a review!

notes.title: v1.0.15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
NEW in this version:
* Fixed a bug, that could potentially lead to a broken level after collecting the third armor piece

Thank you for playing! If you enjoy our game, please consider leaving us a review!

notes.title: Professor Doctor Jetpack - Out Now!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Professor Doctor Jetpack is now available on all platforms on Steam!

After two intensive years of development, we are very proud to be able to present the full game to the public.

We truly hope you are having as much fun playing Professor Doctor Jetpack, as we had developing it!

Thank you for your support! Have fun,

Timo & Clemens, a.k.a. Roflcopter Ink

notes.title: Games Baked in Germany 2024
notes.content:
We are proud to be part of the [b]Games Baked in Germany[/b] Steam Sale Event 2024. In celebration of the event, we are happy to share an exclusive preview demo of our new game with you, ahead of the full release this summer! 

We hope you enjoy it, as much as we do!
